mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts (HOUST) indicate strong consumer demand and economic activity, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as businesses anticipate higher earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST shows a 3-month growth rate above 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 2.0% signals an active monetary tightening cycle, which typically compresses equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment rate and federal funds rate signals a dual stress of labor market weakness and monetary tightening, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising UNRATE and rising FEDFUNDS fails to predict negative 60-day returns in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals an impending economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In the late-cycle expansion regime, INDPRO growth below 0.0% (YoY) fails to predict negative 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Rising inflation (CPIAUCSL) typically leads to higher interest rates and reduced equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL shows a 3-month growth rate above 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A falling unemployment rate below 3.5% signals a very tight labor market that may lead to inflationary pressures and subsequent monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE is below 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) signals a broad-based economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of declining HOUST and declining INDPRO fails to predict negative 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In a high labor market tightness regime, a slowdown in nonfarm payrolls growth below 1.0% year-over-year signals an impending economic deceleration, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In the high labor market tightness regime, PAYEMS growth below 1.0% (YoY) fails to predict negative 5-day returns in more than 55% of cases.
